summoner.line: Glass cracks. Cold fluid spills across the floor. You wake inside a shattered capsule, deep in Doc Croc's laboratory — alone, and with no idea how long you were in there.
summoner.line2: A memory flashes: the wizard Glamrax, pointing at you... and the crocodile in the lab coat, doing exactly as he was told.
summoner.line3: You don't know how long you were gone. You only know one thing — you need to get home. You run.

mage.line: The evil wizard Glamrax struck you down and left you for dead in the rain. He thinks you are gone. He is wrong.

rock.line: Your son has been taken by the evil wizard Glamrax. He has been imprisoned in a crystal suspended over the Abyss Volcano. Save him.

archer.line: Your little sister has been taken by the evil wizard Glamrax. She has been imprisoned in a crystal suspended over the Abyss Volcano. Save her.

mainQuests.title: Defeat Doc Croc
mainQuests.blurb: Glamrax's trail leads east. A crocodile who calls himself a doctor guards the way — he has to be dealt with first.

steps: Step through the portal into the Crimson Wastes
Fight your way to the Warlord's Keep
mainQuests.blurb: "The wizard is not who you think he is." Doc Croc's last words, and a portal that should not exist. Something waits in the blood-red lands beyond.

bestText.green: The meadow’s most common resident. Bouncy, curious, and a little too brave.
bestText.blue: Cooler-headed than its green cousins, and it hits a little harder.
bestText.red: Hot-tempered. Its lunges come sooner than you expect.
bestText.silver: Metal-bodied and armored. Hard to crack, generous when it does.
bestText.gold: A glittering rarity that would rather run than fight. Worth the chase.
bestText.rat: Skittering pond-bank pests that rush in for a quick bite.
bestText.ferret: Springy little hunters that pounce, then hop back to try again.
bestText.boar: Paws the ground before a straight-line charge. Jump it or get out of the way.
bestText.tortoise: Slow and heavily shelled. Ducks inside when struck, then spins into you.
bestText.evileye: A loose eyeball, nerve still trailing behind it like a tail. It watches, then dives.
bestText.hand: A severed hand that scuttles on its fingertips, leaps and claws. A shiny one will grab you and squeeze until you mash free.
bestText.feet: Two severed feet that still walk in step, as if their owner were there. They leap and stomp.
bestText.head: A floating head with empty, glowing sockets. It drifts close and snaps its jaws.
bestText.torso: A torso walking upside-down on its own hands. It punches and swipes with whatever is in reach.
bestText.hairball: A tangled, spiky ball of hair. It bristles, then rolls straight through you.
bestText.cknight: A soldier of the Warlord in crimson plate. A quick sword, and a shield charge that knocks you down.
bestText.ccrusader: A heavier knight with a two-handed sword: broad, crushing strikes and a leaping downward slash.
bestText.warlord: An undead knight three times the size of his soldiers, bare bone where the armour gaps. Switches between sword-and-shield and greatsword, throws his blade, sends his eyes hunting, and calls down the Crimson Rain.
bestText.croc: A crocodile in a lab coat and spectacles who calls himself a scientist. Bites on all fours, swipes when he rears up, stomps rocks loose from the ceiling, and lobs poison vials he mixes on the spot.

statTips.Level: Your level. Monsters well above it give much more EXP; ones well below give less.
statTips.Boss Coins: Earned by defeating bosses. A Boss Shop to spend them in is coming.
statTips.EXP: Experience toward your next level. Each level gives 3 attribute points and 3 skill points.
statTips.Max HP: How much damage you can take. Raised by VIT, armor, potions and some skills.
statTips.Attack: Base damage for every hit and skill. Raised by STR, your weapon, charms and buffs.
statTips.Defense: Reduces damage taken from every hit. Raised by VIT and gear.
statTips.Critical rate: Chance for a hit to be critical. Raised by DEX, charms and some skills (max 80%).
statTips.Critical damage: How hard critical hits land, as a multiple of normal damage.
statTips.Move speed: How fast you walk and run. Raised by AGI and some skills.
statTips.Attack speed: How quickly your attack animations play. Raised by AGI, skills and engravings.
statTips.Monsters defeated: Every monster you have defeated with this hero.
statTips.Best combo: The highest style rank you have finished a combo with.

matTips.green: Sticky green goo scraped off a slime. It wobbles. It reminds you of snot.
matTips.blue: Cool blue slime residue. Faintly minty, and colder than it has any right to be.
matTips.red: Warm red residue that fizzes on your fingers. Please do not lick it.
matTips.silver: Heavy, metallic goo from a Silver Slime. It sets like quicksilver when it cools.
matTips.gold: Glittering residue from a Gold Slime. Merchants pretend not to be impressed by it.
matTips.rat: A long, pink, slightly crusty rat tail. Somebody, somewhere, needs these.
matTips.ferret: A tuft of soft ferret fur, still warm and smelling faintly of mischief.
matTips.boar: A curved boar tusk, chipped from charging into things it should not have.
matTips.tortoise: A mossy fragment of tortoise shell. Things are still growing on it.

curTips.coin: Coins: dropped by every monster. Spend them on gear, charms, arrows and cosmetics.
curTips.boss: Boss Coins: one for each boss you defeat. Saved for the Boss Shop.
curTips.abyss: Abyssal Coins: cold, faintly humming coins dropped by the swarms an Obelisk calls up. Spent in the Abyssal Shop.
curTips.cards: Monster cards: rare drops shown in the Bestiary and the Trophy Hall. Every card permanently raises EXP and coins from ALL monsters, for every hero (card +3%, shiny +4%, gold +10%, shiny gold +12%).
